items.title: Inland American Announces Sale of Select Service Hotel Portfolio for $1.1 Billion
items.summary: Transaction is Another Important Step in Inland Americans Long-Term Strategy Execution Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. (Inland American or the Company) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell a portfolio consisting of 52 select service hotels with 6,976 rooms to a joint venture formed by affiliates of Northstar Realty Finance Corp. (Northstar) and Chatham Lodging Trust (Chatham) for approximately $1.1 billion. Inland American expects to realize approximately $480.0 million of net proceeds as a result of the transaction (after the prepayment of indebtedness encumbering the hotel assets). The Company currently expects to use the net proceeds from the transaction to advance the growth strategy of its student housing and retail portfolios, which includes, among other things, acquisitions, debt reduction and general corporate purposes.
